reviewNotes: Phase 3 builds the history module (HistoryEntry entity, HistoryRepository + InMemory, JsonlHistoryRepository, RecordCommandUseCase, history_module) out of types::HistoryEntry and inline::History, and registers `history` in the architecture test. inline.rs (ghost text, LLM) stays until Phase 7 and engine.rs until Phase 6; they switch to the new history types/ports but keep their own logic. Read docs/hexagonal-refactor/source-map/inline.md and docs/hexagonal-refactor/source-map/types.md (HistoryEntry, History traps). Do not demand later-phase work. steps.title: HistoryEntry entity without serde + HistoryRecord in the adapter
steps.prompt: Read docs/hexagonal-refactor/phase-3-history.md first. Plan Phase 3 step 1. Read docs/hexagonal-refactor/source-map/inline.md and docs/hexagonal-refactor/source-map/types.md first (HistoryEntry / History traps). Move types::HistoryEntry to src/history/domain/entities/history_entry.rs with no serde. The on-disk JSONL contract moves to a serde `HistoryRecord` in src/history/infrastructure/adapters/jsonl_history_repository.rs (created here; the repository itself comes in step 2) with EXACTLY today's wire format: field order command, shell, pid, session_id, cwd, start_time, end_time, exit_code, hostname; None written as null (no skip_serializing_if); NO #[serde(default)] (lines missing command/shell/session_id/start_time keep being dropped); unknown fields ignored; `shell` stays the raw marker string (not the Shell VO). Domain fields private (plan section 1): give HistoryEntry a constructor and the accessors/transitions its users need (tracker.rs mutates exit_code/end_time and builds it with ..Default::default(); engine, suggest, inline read fields). Keep structural PartialEq/Clone/Debug/Default derives that tests rely on (identity-based equality would make history_file_round_trip_and_compaction's assert vacuous; the glossary's identity (session id, start time) can be an explicit method). Add to_primitives() only if the adapter mapping needs it (plan section 1 lists HistoryEntry among the persisted entities). Switch every user (types.rs re-export may stay as a shim only within this phase). Tests that build entries with struct literals switch to the constructor/builder: same field values, allowed restructuring.

steps.title: HistoryRepository + InMemory + JsonlHistoryRepository
steps.prompt: Read docs/hexagonal-refactor/phase-3-history.md first. Plan Phase 3 step 2. Test-first: src/history/domain/repositories/history_repository.rs `trait HistoryRepository { append, recent }` + `InMemoryHistoryRepository` in the same file. It is a PRODUCTION type (not #[cfg(test)]): History::load falls back to memory-only via from_entries when the data directory cannot be resolved (logs `history: {e:#}` at warn, D5), and append caps memory at HISTORY_IN_MEMORY (5000). `recent` must return exactly what History::entries returns today (the load-time snapshot + this process's own appends, oldest to newest, <= 5000) -- never re-read the file. The engine thread owns the history today (&mut); a trait with &self needs interior mutability (RefCell is fine on one thread). Then move inline::History (load, load_from, append, compact, open_private, the HISTORY_* constants) into JsonlHistoryRepository verbatim: strict per-line parse, read error -> empty, compaction at > 10_000 down to 5000 via `history.tmp-<pid>` + rename (REPLACES a symlink; do NOT route it through shared AtomicFile), 0600 only on create, purge guard (parent gone -> skip the write, do not recreate, still push to memory, do not count the line), write error -> warn `history: appending to {path}: {e}` and still push. The blank-command skip at the adapter stays (the moved test asserts it; D1). Move history_file_round_trip_and_compaction with it. Path from DataDirectory's history file (lazy, D3). Switch engine.rs/inline.rs users to the trait/adapter.

steps.title: RecordCommandUseCase + history_module + register history
steps.prompt: Read docs/hexagonal-refactor/phase-3-history.md first. Plan Phase 3 step 3. Test-first with InMemoryHistoryRepository: src/history/application/record_command_use_case.rs `RecordCommandUseCase` (blank commands are skipped; otherwise append). src/history/infrastructure/history_module.rs `HistoryModule` + `build_history_module(&SharedDependencies) -> HistoryModule` (lazy data directory, memory-only fallback exactly as History::load does today) and src/history/domain/history_error.rs only if a fallible operation needs it. Switch the engine's CommandFinished path (engine.rs, which stays legacy until Phase 6) to append through the use case or the repository with identical effects and log lines; the engine thread is where the history lives today, so build it there (QuickJS is !Send; keep threads as they are). Delete the old inline::History and the types::HistoryEntry shim. Register `history` in architecture_tests.rs REGISTERED_MODULES (must pass without weakening the test). Full gate PASS.
